title: Ladybug wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,38 62,38' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,22 56,22' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 47,15 53,15' fill='#44DDFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#FF44AA'/>
  <rect x='37' y='34' width='26' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FF44CC'/>
  <!-- Pom pom stripes on hat -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#FF44AA'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#FF44AA'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#44DDFF'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#44DDFF'/>
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <line x1='40' y1='40' x2='32' y2='28' stroke='#FF6B8A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='40' x2='68' y2='28' stroke='#FF6B8A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='26' r='3' fill='#FF2244'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='26' r='3' fill='#FF2244'/>
  <!-- Body (ladybug) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#FF2244'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#2A1A3A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#4A2A5A'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='41' r='2.2' fill='#1A0A2A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='41' r='2.2' fill='#1A0A2A'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='40' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58.8' cy='40' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45,46 Q50,50 55,46' fill='none' stroke='#FF88AA' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Wing line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='86' stroke='#1A0A2A' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='86' stroke='#3A1A4A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='56' r='4.5' fill='#1A0A2A'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='56' r='4.5' fill='#1A0A2A'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='70' r='4' fill='#1A0A2A'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='70' r='4' fill='#1A0A2A'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='78' r='3.5' fill='#1A0A2A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='78' r='3.5' fill='#1A0A2A'/>
  <!-- Shadow under body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='22' ry='3' fill='#FF5577' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <line x1='26' y1='58' x2='16' y2='52' stroke='#2A1A3A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='26' y1='66' x2='16' y2='68' stroke='#2A1A3A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='74' x2='18' y2='80' stroke='#2A1A3A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='58' x2='84' y2='52' stroke='#2A1A3A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='66' x2='84' y2='68' stroke='#2A1A3A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='74' x2='82' y2='80' stroke='#2A1A3A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
